title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.10
body_markdown:
## Performance improvements


- enforce registry cache capacity invariants ([#3262](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3262) )
- retry transient registry cache contention ([#3264](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3264) )


## Bug fixes


- return adjacent reverse pages ([#3258](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3258) )
- retry actions after heartbeat timeouts ([#3266](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3266) )


## Other


- add universal cursor pagination ([#3256](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3256) )
